name: Adista Nancy/Maxéville datacenters SJ1 and SJ2
notes: L'Est Républicain reports Adista has two data centers in Maxéville in the Nancy area; Data Center Map identifies SJ1 at 1 Rue Blaise Pascal and SJ2 in ZI Saint Jacques 2; capacity not disclosed.

name: Datacenter Mutualisé Lorrain (DCML), Vandœuvre-lès-Nancy
developer: Université de Lorraine / CHRU Nancy-Brabois / Métropole du Grand Nancy / CNRS
notes: DCD reports the shared DCML facility in Vandœuvre-lès-Nancy was inaugurated after EUR8.24m investment, in production since October 2023, with 1,600 sqm building area and 700 sqm IT space; MW not disclosed.

name: Pharmagest/Welcoop Villers-lès-Nancy private data center
notes: Usine Nouvelle reported Pharmagest, a Welcoop subsidiary, inaugurated a data center in Villers-lès-Nancy, Meurthe-et-Moselle; capacity not disclosed.

name: Morbihan Terradata public departmental data center, Vannes
notes: Official Morbihan Énergies project page says a public departmental data center will be built on its Vannes administrative site, with ISO 27001 and HDS target security/certification levels; Ouest-France Hit West reports the 'green' Vannes data center reserved for local collectivities was expected by end of the year.

name: Lorient Agglomération low-carbon public data center
notes: Official Lorient Agglomération announcement says the low-carbon containerized data center was inaugurated to host public-service data, with local backup data center replication; investment reported at EUR1.6m.

name: Saint-Avold / Émile-Huchet power station data center proposal
notes: GazelEnergie plans a 300 MW data center at its Émile-Huchet site in Saint-Avold (Moselle), supported by the 'loi Saint-Avold' adopted April 2025 enabling site conversion; La Gazette France cites a 2028 horizon; works on the wider energy hub are expected from 2026 while partner discussions for the data center continued.

name: APL/Abalone data center (first in Moselle)
notes: APL reference page describes construction of the first data center in Moselle for Abalone Group (temporary-work group) with 99.982% availability target, Tier III architecture evolvable to Tier IV, multi-operator fiber; commune and capacity not disclosed.

name: Databalt Nevers data center
notes: Databalt states its headquarters and main site are in Nevers; business registry and cluster listings describe creation/management of datacenters, hosting, backup, GPU compute, and PRA/PCA services at Avenue du Colonel Rossel, 58000 Nevers.

name: DATA4 Escaudain AI data center campus
notes: DATA4 announced a EUR5bn campus on the former Usinor/Parc des Soufflantes industrial site in Escaudain; Mediacités (2026-06-19) reports DATA4 was chosen by Porte du Hainaut agglomeration for the 700 MW AI campus on 38 ha; France 3 says Escaudain would host France's largest data center by 2030 with up to 2,400 jobs.

name: SoftBank AI data center, Dunkirk (Loon-Plage)
developer: SoftBank Group / SB Energy / strategic partners
notes: SoftBank announced a 5GW France AI infrastructure program; first phase totals 3.1GW in Hauts-de-France by 2031 and names Dunkirk (Loon-Plage), Bosquel, and Bouchain as data center locations; Euronews reports EUR 75bn investment. Individual site MW not disclosed.

name: SoftBank AI data center, Bouchain
developer: SoftBank Group / EDF / SB Energy / strategic partners
notes: SoftBank named Bouchain as one of three first-phase Hauts-de-France AI data center locations; the release says EDF is involved for the Bouchain site. Individual site MW not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Quaëdypre data center proposal
notes: DCD, citing La Voix du Nord, reports Microsoft was looking at a 20.5-hectare data center site in Quaëdypre, Hauts de Flandre, in the Nord department; Microsoft had not confirmed specifications or timeline.

name: OVHcloud Roubaix data center region / campus
notes: OVHcloud official materials list Roubaix among its French 1-AZ regions and its status page lists multiple Roubaix zones (RBX-1 through RBX-10).

name: OVHcloud Gravelines data center region / campus
notes: OVHcloud official materials list Gravelines among its French 1-AZ regions and its status page lists Gravelines zones; local reporting says OVH began the Gravelines site in a former Rexam factory and later expanded capacity.

name: Rantigny digital campus / data center (Vallée Dorée)
developer: Rantigny Data Center (RDC) / Communauté de communes du Liancourtois - Vallée Dorée
notes: Official Vallée Dorée page describes the Rantigny data center project as cloud/AI infrastructure with a 300MW grid connection; DCMag reports the project targets two hyperscalers on the former Caterpillar/Avon industrial site (up to 60 ha); actu.fr reports an AI-specialized data center planned by 2029 with public consultation until 26 Aug; project company Rantigny Data Center (RDC) registered at Choisy-au-Bac in July 2024.

name: AZNETWORK Alençon data center
notes: AZNETWORK says it owns a 100% French data center for hosting infrastructure and lists its address at 40 Rue Ampère, 61000 Alençon; Orne departmental material describes AZNetwork as having created a regional data center for up to 1,000 servers.

name: Telehouse Paris Voltaire
notes: Telehouse official Paris page identifies Voltaire as a core Paris internet hub (France-IX, 80%+ of national internet traffic); ISO certificate lists Telehouse Voltaire at 137 Boulevard Voltaire, Paris 75011 for co-location facilities.

name: Telehouse Paris Jeûneurs
notes: Telehouse says Paris Jeûneurs opened in 1996; ISO certificate lists the site at 38 Rue des Jeuneurs, Paris 75002 for co-location facilities.

name: Nebius / Azur Datacenter Béthune AI data center
notes: La Voix du Nord (2025-09) reports Azur Datacenter will launch an AI data center at Béthune (former Bridgestone site, 26,000 sq m rehabilitated building) from early 2026 with 38.5 MW first-phase consumption and extensions planned; the wider Nebius/Azur program targets 240 MW with phased delivery.

name: Microsoft Vieille-Église data center proposal
notes: DCD, citing La Voix du Nord, reports Microsoft was looking to develop a data center outside Calais in Vieille-Église, Pas-de-Calais; company confirmation, specifications, and timeline were not available.

name: Microsoft Zouafques data center proposal
notes: DCD, citing La Voix du Nord, reports Microsoft was looking to develop another Pas-de-Calais facility in Zouafques; company confirmation, specifications, and timeline were not available.

name: o2switch Clermont-Ferrand data centers
notes: o2switch states that it owns and manages its own data centers in Clermont-Ferrand, France, with 24/7 operations and services hosted in France without an intermediary.

name: Pau public proximity data center
developer: Communauté d'Agglomération Pau Béarn Pyrénées / Fibre Paloise / Axione
notes: Pau official page says the first public proximity data center in Pyrénées-Atlantiques is under construction near the municipal technical center and due in October 2027; DCMag reports 120kW IT environment, 450 sqm main building, and Tier 3-aligned resilience; Clubic describes the unusual proximity data center replacing an ageing server room.

name: Adamentis Le Boulou / Perpignan datacenter
notes: Operator describes a Tier 3+ sovereign datacenter at Le Boulou near Perpignan, in Pyrénées-Orientales.

name: Conseil départemental des Pyrénées-Orientales datacenter project
notes: Department launched/advanced a datacenter initiative targeted for 2024; no public MW figure found.

name: nLighten Lyon edge datacenter
notes: Operator page lists Lyon edge location with 1.2 MW power capacity and carrier/cloud connectivity.

name: LyonTech-la-Doua CCDD datacenter
notes: Campus Datacenter de Données Durable at LyonTech-la-Doua; sources describe a 300-rack research/campus datacenter project.

name: Azur Datacenter Lyon-Meyzieu
notes: Azur Datacenter is converting a former solar-panel factory in Meyzieu Industrial Park, Rhône, into a datacenter; public MW not found.

name: Penta Lyon Saint-Priest data center project
notes: Le Progrès (2026-05-22) reports Penta Lyon wants to build a data center in Saint-Priest, Métropole de Lyon; following the public consultation, the Rhône prefect will decide whether to authorize the project, possibly with environmental prescriptions; capacity not disclosed.

name: Sartel Sartera datacenter
notes: Local-government datacenter in Sarthe; reported as a 394 kW facility; APL reference page describes the eco-designed first public proximity data center in Sarthe (target PUE 1.25).

name: DATAGREX Tiers III datacenter near Le Mans
notes: DATAGREX states it operates a Tiers III datacenter about 15 minutes from Le Mans.

name: Eclairion Bessé-sur-Braye hyperscale datacenter campus
notes: Eclairion site portfolio lists Bessé-sur-Braye at 335 MW; trade press also reported the Sarthe campus.

name: Savoie Technolac efficient datacenter
developer: Savoie Technolac / Schneider Electric / HP / APL
notes: Project announced for Savoie Technolac with high-efficiency design; source described a 300-rack, 450 sq m facility. No later public MW figure found.

name: LMSI datacenter, Savoie Technolac
notes: Aggregate listing for LMSI datacenter at Savoie Technolac near Chambéry.

name: Mâcon hyperscale datacenter campus
notes: Quaero Capital and Euclyde announced plans for a hyperscale campus in Mâcon with 20 MW of installed power.

name: DTiX Chalon-sur-Saône datacenter
notes: DTiX operates a Chalon-sur-Saône/Châtenoy-le-Royal colocation facility; press reported 80 bays and 350 sq m IT surface.

name: Le Creusot data center (first Saône-et-Loire hosting datacenter)
developer: Local operator (reported by L'InfoRmateur de Bourgogne)
notes: L'InfoRmateur de Bourgogne reports the first IT-hosting data center of Saône-et-Loire implanted at Le Creusot, with doubled electrical, cooling, fire and fiber infrastructure; operator name and capacity not disclosed in the visible report.
